note: 第 26 增量（状态过渡必须以指数减速到达）的裁决簿。★ 键 = `<相对文件>|<选择器>|<属性>`（**不带行号**：行号会随文件改动漂移 ⇒ 用行号当键的门是「行号错的门」，比没有门更坏）。
basis: "Use natural deceleration such as `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for confident arrivals; do not use bounce or elastic curves by reflex. Long feedback feels like latency."
"Avoid casually animating layout-driving properties such as `width`, `height`, `top`, `left`, and margins; use FLIP, transforms, or grid techniques when appropriate."

"Every web animation needs a `prefers-reduced-motion` path with an intentional alternative. ... Reduced motion means fewer and gentler animations, not disabling all motion; feedback that confirms an action should remain legible."
时长表：100–150ms 反馈 / 150–300ms 例行状态变化 / 300–500ms 浮层与视图过渡 / 500–800ms 刻意编排的焦点入场

"one authored moment, not scattered effects and not one identical entrance on every section. Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default. Reach past transform and opacity: blur, backdrop-filter, clip-path, mask, and shadow belong to the palette when they stay smooth."
仓内 DESIGN.md §8「Do」已列「尊重 prefers-reduced-motion」；本轮把它落成可执行判据（M4）。
